messages.subject: Problem with pooling replicate data
parts:
Hi,

I have two biological replicates for each sample, but the genome coverage (10X each) of reads is not that high. So I would like to pool the replicates as one sample and then use it for DMR identification between samples.

I used the following code and it was returning the following error. When i checked the group discussion, another user had the same problem but the solution was not provided.
Could you help me fix this?

> file.list=list("HOR_10350_S12_CpG.txt","HOR_10350_S51_CpG.txt","HOR_21599_S15_CpG.txt","HOR_21599_S54_CpG.txt")
> myobj=methRead(file.list,
+            sample.id=list("HOR_10350_S12","HOR_10350_S51","HOR_21599_S15","HOR_21599_S54"),
+            assembly="morex_V2",
+            treatment=c(1,1,0,0),
+            context="CpG"
+            )

> pooled.methylBase=pool(myobj,sample.ids=c("HOR_10350","HOR_21599"))

Error in (function (classes, fdef, mtable)  :
  unable to find an inherited method for function ‘pool’ for signature ‘"methylRawList"’

Thanks.

Regards,
Sudharsan

--
 
Dr. Sudharsan Padmarasu
